youtube.title: Why You Can't See Your Own Nose 👃 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Your nose sits inside your field of view all the time, yet you almost never notice it. The brain uses neural adaptation to ignore constant, unchanging signals, and it blends the slightly different images from each eye. Close one eye and the nose pops into view because the brain stops filtering it the same way.
